cells.gaps: No admitted fact says where the computerised Civil Status record is entered, at the offices at Praslin, La Digue and Anse Royale or centrally, nor how many local offices enter it; the only rows on `made` and `offices` (SYC-001, SYC-002) are from the excluded source. The one placing fact is dated 2018-08-10, and nothing on governance or the last twelve months falls inside the windows: SYC-004 to SYC-006 (owner:ministry, latest 2022-11-01) are older than 36 months and are not carried.
cells.note: A computerised record of vital events is kept beside the manual register and updated daily (SYC-003), so a system runs, but nothing shows it live in a local office or how the record is made, which stage 3 needs. Identity integrated is set on SYC-003 with systems.csv: the record feeds the National Population Database, with which the NIN was introduced; section 18A's digital copies of closed registers are law only and set no backlog flag.
